summary: End-to-end UI testing for the admin dashboard + data-driven product pages task (La Maison d'Auben, Stripe TEST preview). Validated: (A) Catalogue /boutique shows 6 cards — Budget mensuel with price '7,99 €' and 'Découvrir' CTA; the 5 coming_soon products (Budget Couple, Car Cost, First Apartment, Suivi sportif, Travel Manager) each show 'Bientôt disponible' badge + clickable 'En savoir plus' link to their own fiche. (B) /boutique/budget-mensuel renders the full rich content (Présentation + audience, Fonctionnalités, Galerie, Ce que vous recevez, Compatibilité, FAQ), displays 7,99 €, and exposes both data-testid='buy-now-btn' and 'buy-now-btn-final'. Clicking buy-now-btn redirects to checkout.stripe.com with a cs_test_ session (verified, no payment entered). (C) /boutique/suivi-sportif and /boutique/car-cost render the SAME rich sections (Présentation, Fonctionnalités, Compatibilité, FAQ) but display the 'Bientôt disponible' encart and have NO buy-now-btn / NO buy-now-btn-final — the final CTA is 'coming-soon-cta-final'. (D) Admin login (/admin/login) with admin@lamaisondauben.fr/Auben2026! succeeds; Produits tab lists all 6 products with the expected data-testids per slug: admin-product-status-<slug>, admin-product-file-<slug>, admin-price-input-<slug>, admin-price-save-<slug>, upload-file-<slug>, upload-main-image-<slug>, and delete-file-<slug> ONLY when a file is present (present only on budget-mensuel initially, and on budget-couple after upload). (E) Admin price edit on budget-couple: filled 5.99 → Enregistrer le prix → toast 'Prix mis à jour !' and value persisted on reload. (F) Admin upload on budget-couple: uploaded /tmp/Budget-mensuel-DEFAULT.xlsx via the hidden input (data-testid='upload-file-budget-couple'); status flipped to 'Disponible', file label became 'Fichier prêt · Budget-mensuel-DEFAULT.xlsx', delete button appeared. /boutique/budget-couple then exposed buy-now-btn, and clicking it redirected to checkout.stripe.com with a cs_test_ session (no payment entered). (G) Admin delete on budget-couple: clicked 'Supprimer le fichier', accepted the confirm dialog → status reverted to 'Bientôt disponible', delete button disappeared; /boutique/budget-couple no longer shows buy-now-btn. (H) Regression: /boutique/budget-mensuel still shows 7,99 €, Fonctionnalités, and a working buy-now-btn after the budget-couple mutations — description/features of other products untouched. (I) Final cleanup: budget-couple file deleted and price cleared via UI (back to coming_soon / price=null) as requested. Backend was already validated via 52/52 pytest in iteration_6 and curl in current task — no backend re-run performed this iteration (frontend focus).
critical_code_review_comments: The data-testid 'upload-file-<slug>' is attached directly to the hidden <input type=file class=hidden>; this is fine for Playwright (set_input_files works) but tests that click() the testid will fail with 'Element is not visible'. If future UI tests want to drive the file picker through the visible button, consider adding a separate data-testid='upload-file-trigger-<slug>' on the clickable <label>/<button> and keep the current id on the input for direct file injection.

Admin products API exposes an internal field name 'digital_file' on budget-mensuel that is null on the public /api/products response while the admin UI still correctly shows 'Fichier prêt · Budget-mensuel.xlsx' — ensure the admin endpoint returns the authoritative file reference and that the 'purchasable' flag computed server-side is the single source of truth for the shop (verified true here, keep it that way).

Minor UX: after a successful price save on a coming_soon product the field is left populated with the new value but the row's 'Bientôt disponible' badge does not change (correct — needs a file to flip). The admin instructions text already states this; good.
test_credentials: Admin admin@lamaisondauben.fr / Auben2026! via /admin/login — works. No real Stripe payment performed; only redirect to checkout.stripe.com with cs_test_ session verified for budget-mensuel and budget-couple-after-upload.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily uploaded /tmp/Budget-mensuel-DEFAULT.xlsx to budget-couple and set its price to 5.99 for the test, then DELETED the file and cleared the price via the admin UI. Final persisted state of budget-couple: status=coming_soon, no file, no price — identical to the state before this iteration. Budget-mensuel file/price untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The admin upload data-testid points at the hidden <input type=file>, so use page.set_input_files('[data-testid="upload-file-<slug>"]', path) rather than page.click(). The delete-file button triggers a native confirm() dialog — register page.once('dialog', d.accept()) before clicking. Clicking buy-now-btn on an available product navigates away to checkout.stripe.com; use page.expect_navigation() with a fresh page/context so you don't lose the admin session. budget-couple is the safe sandbox product for upload/delete/price mutations; always restore it (DELETE file + empty price save) at the end. Never touch budget-mensuel's file or price in the preview — it is the only truly purchasable product and the Stripe test fixture.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. The task's 11 UI scenarios all pass as specified.
